faults.title: Front-seat frame squeaks
faults.description: Corrosion around the front-seat hinges or adjustment mechanism can cause squeaks in the F30. Move each seat through its range and have the frame and mechanism inspected if noise persists.

faults.title: Bluetooth pairing failure
faults.description: Some F30 cars have trouble connecting a phone over Bluetooth. Test pairing and reconnection with a current phone; the reported remedy can be a software update from a BMW workshop.
